_source: generated by `python -m mccontrol.webexport` from mccontrol/envelope.py, mccontrol/token.py, mccontrol/mesh.py, mccontrol/mcc3.py; do not edit

_mesh_layout.request: subtype(1) | counter(4 LE) | expiry(4 LE) | raw Ed25519 signature(64) | command UTF-8; the companion prepends its 4-byte tag
_mesh_layout.response: after the tag: node clock(4 LE, unset below clock_set_from) | counter(4 LE) | code(1) | reply UTF-8, possibly cut inside a character (drop the partial one)
_mesh_layout.topic: meshcore/{REGION upper}/{whole key upper}/cmd, or meshcore/mesh/{key}/cmd on a mesh-only node

_mcc3_heard_layout.heard: base64url without padding of: kind 0x48, nonce (12, random), then sealed with K_heard (ChaCha20-Poly1305, AAD the kind and the nonce, tag 16): the announced node's key (32), the announce from its kind byte to its tag (68), heard_at (u32 LE, the catching node's clock, 0 while unset), snr (i8, quarter dB), hops (u8), then the same three for the node's last advert (0: none)
_mcc3_heard_layout.K_heard: HKDF-SHA256(X25519(owner, catching node), salt empty, info hkdf_info with <KEY> the catching node's key as 64 upper-case hex)
_mcc3_heard_layout.announce: the announced key's first byte, then the heard entry's first 100 bytes: byte 0, node key (1..32), kind 0x4D (33), owner tag (34..37), boot (38..41, u32 LE), sequence (42..45), 47 bytes sealed with K_malive (ChaCha20-Poly1305, nonce 00 x 4 then boot then sequence, AAD bytes 1..45), then the first 8 bytes of the tag
_mcc3_heard_layout.K_malive: HKDF-SHA256(X25519(owner, announced node), salt empty, info announce.hkdf_info with <KEY> the announced node's key as 64 upper-case hex)
_mcc3_heard_layout.owner_tag: SHA-256(owner_tag_label, command key, node key, boot, sequence), first 4 bytes
_mcc3_heard_layout.sealed: uptime (u32 LE), clock (u32, 0 while unset), last command counter (u32), flags (u8, the alive message's), battery in millivolts (u16, 0: unknown), version (length byte, at most max_version), name (length byte, at most max_name, cut), zeros to 47
_mcc3_heard_layout.reading: open the heard entry of each of your own Observer nodes, then the announce inside; one that does not open is dropped silently; the newest (boot, sequence) per announced node is kept
